keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms to look up (1-20). Each keyword is queried separately, so its 0-100 interest values are scaled to that keyword only and are not comparable across keywords.

geo.title: Region
geo.description: Two-letter country code (e.g. US) or sub-region (e.g. US-CA). Leave empty for worldwide.

timeRange.title: Time range
timeRange.description: One of: now 1-H, now 4-H, now 1-d, now 7-d, today 1-m, today 3-m, today 12-m, today 5-y, all, or a custom range "YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD" (from 2004-01-01).

category.title: Category
category.description: Google Trends category ID. 0 means all categories.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language for labels and related queries, e.g. en-US.

includeRelatedQueries.title: Include related queries
includeRelatedQueries.description: Collect top and rising related queries for each keyword.

includeRelatedTopics.title: Include related topics (experimental)
includeRelatedTopics.description: Experimental. In testing, Google returned related topics as empty for automated requests, so expect status "empty".

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a request after a rate-limit (429) or server error before marking that section as failed.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Google rate-limits automated requests heavily. Residential proxy is recommended.
